in_marathi.name: Devalanth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devalanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devalanth is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ which means ‘God’ and ‘Alankara’ which means ‘abode’ or ‘dwelling’. In Hindu mythology, this name is believed to be associated with the divine abode of the gods. It symbolizes a connection to the divine and a spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
